content: QED is up to 0.815. Step 2 installs the anilide, and the position matters: the ring runs 8-9-10-11-13-15, so atom 11 - the carbon bearing the chlorine - is para to atom 8, which carries the arylamine. That is the arrangement every active molecule I have measured uses. The chlorine itself is the right thing to sacrifice, since a halogen on this central ring measured slightly negative. So I cut the non-ring 11-12 bond and attach an N-linked cyclopropanecarboxamide there, giving a conjugated anilide N-H para to the arylamine N-H.
